single.rationale: Collegium shows solid revenue growth and strong cash generation, but faces imminent generic competition for Nucynta products (launched Feb 2026) which represented a significant portion of revenue. While the Jornay PM acquisition diversifies into ADHD and early results appear positive, the company carries substantial debt ($580M term loan + $242M convertible notes) and operates in heavily regulated opioid markets with litigation/regulatory risks.

team.thesis: Collegium operates a capital-light commercial model generating $327.6M free cash flow (42.0% margin) from pain and ADHD products, yet faces immediate revenue erosion as Nucynta ER lost regulatory exclusivity December 27, 2025 and Nukynta IR generic launched February 2026, while carrying $580.0M term loan debt and $241.5M convertible notes against only $231.3M cash, with zero R&D spending since Apr
